en.title: Maximum Total Transfer from Choosing Distinct Ordered Server Pairs
en.description:
Choose pipelineCount distinct ordered index pairs (i,j); each pair contributes throughput[i]+throughput[j]. i=j is allowed, and (i,j) and (j,i) are different; different servers with the same capacity also have different identities. Find the maximum total.

The standard I/O, examples and editorial were written independently by this site; ranges explicitly marked as this site's are not the source's original constraints.
en.input: The first line contains n pipelineCount; the second line contains throughput. The original text had no numeric bounds; this site uses 1≤n≤200000, 1≤throughput[i]≤10^9, 1≤pipelineCount≤n²; use 64 bits for K. This site requires the exact integer to be output; the maximum answer 8×10^19 exceeds the signed 64-bit range, and no modulo is taken.
en.output: Output a single integer, the answer.
en.explanation: The answers are 36, 16 and 42. In the third example the top 3 are 20, 11 and 11, and both directions must be counted.
hints: Binary search the K-th largest pair sum T. After sorting, use two pointers and prefix sums to get the count C and the total S of all pairs with sum ≥T; the result is S−(C−K)T.
